gloss_en: Bat (בַּת, 'daughter') as an exegetical unit — the 'daughter' of 'Avraham had a daughter and Bakol was her name' (Bava Batra 16b), which R. Nachman expounds as the bat-component of the word Shabbat (shin + bat) and as bat-ayin (pupil of the eye), identified variously with faith, prayer, and blessings; not the word Shabbat itself, not 'house of' (beit), and not a measure (bat)
